notes.title: Crystal fever
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/85a27ad34c50def64a3e94f93c68a67ef9e2d744.png[/img]

Dive into the Crystal Rush and get one of five epic bracelets with special properties:
🔹Bracelet of Destruction - increases the chance of a critical attack by 2%, critical damage by 5%. Only one bracelet of destruction can have this effect at a time
🔹Bracelet of Avoidance - reduces the chance of receiving a critical hit by 6%. Only one bracelet of Avoidance can have this effect at a time.
🔹Bracelet of Resistance - increases magic defense by 12%. Only one bracelet of resistance can have this effect at a time.
🔹Bracelet of Strengthening - increases physical defense by 12%. Only one bracelet of Strengthening can have this effect at a time.
🔹Bracelet of Enhancement - increases the power of abilities by 4%. Only one bracelet of Enhancement can have this effect at a time.

The Crystal Rush is coming to the world of the Sphere! Travelers from all over the continent are talking about the same thing: the Sphere is filled with mysterious magic crystals that contain various secrets and powers. The loyal soldiers of Vagrot and King Sigurd are already preparing to get as many valuable crystals as possible, but this time everyone will not only face war, but also a real competition.

⚡️Rewards⚡️

During Crystal Mania, the factions of people and demons will begin the pursuit of the power of crystals. By killing monsters of your level, you have a chance to get a tarnished shard, from a group of which you can create more powerful crystals. Each time you combine crystals, you will receive pleasant bonuses.

By creating new crystals, you can get:
- items for improvement,
- teleportation stones,
- pet food,
- useful potions,
- illusion cubes,
- resurrection scrolls.

⚡️Guaranteed Prize⚡️

In addition, when combining unfinished crystals, you have a small chance to get a crystal cache containing one of five epic bracelets, and every 25th attempt to combine unfinished crystals, you are guaranteed to get a crystal cache!

⚡️Useful Buffs⚡️

At the end of each day, the faction that has collected more crystals will receive a nice bonus to experience, gold and item drops, which will last until the next count.

And one more thing. For combining unfinished crystals, you will receive a buff that increases the power of abilities by 0.4% and maximum health by 0.7%. The effect stacks up to 40 times, that is, you can increase the power of abilities by 16% and maximum health by 28%. The buff is not lost after the death of the character and will remain with you until the end of the event and 1 week after it.

⚡️Important details⚡️

To get crystals from monsters, your level must not differ from the monster's level by more than 5 levels.

While the premium account is active, the chance of getting tarnished shards is doubled.

Additional shards can be purchased in the in-game store.

You will need cunning, attentiveness and remarkable persistence to get as many prizes as possible and defeat your opponents. Well, enough chatter, the Crystal Rush is starting!

notes.title: 29.01.2025 game update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/7ebc4764d7c89fc4f666047b4fb619eee9654cbf.png[/img]

The following changes were made to the game during maintenance today:

🔹The "Great Concern" event has started.

🔹The construction of siege weapons has been reworked:
▪ The defense decree that slows down the construction of siege weapons no longer applies to allies (clans that are part of the same alliance) of the castle defenders.
▪ Defenders can now build siege weapons both inside and outside the castle, including near its walls, even if the gates are not broken.
▪ Allies of defenders are now allowed to build siege weapons inside and under the castle walls, just like the defenders themselves.
▪ Allies of defenders and defenders are prohibited from building rams, automatic catapults, and airships.
▪ Added a ban on applying positive effects (buffs) to siege weapons.

🔹Fixed the inability to talk to the castle castellan when not in an alliance.
🔹Castle defenders now receive a standard "Sphere of Protection" for 20 seconds when reviving inside the castle.

🔹The war between alliances has been reworked. The following rules now apply:
▪ During a war between alliances, it is prohibited to leave or kick out clan members, as well as disband the clan.
▪ To declare war on another alliance, all clans in your alliance must have positive influence.
▪ You can declare war on another alliance even if the clans in it have negative influence.
▪ After the war, the winning alliance will receive the prize influence only from those losing clans that had non-negative influence at the end of the war.
▪ The losing clans will lose 4500 influence points in any case, even if they already had negative influence at the end of the war.
▪ The losing alliance gets a 5-day grace period until the next war.

🔹Fixed the unnecessary write-off of the royal tax for entering the dungeon when there are no more attempts to enter.
🔹Increased the running speed of the Mummy, Tamed Shieldback and Beast.

🔹Eliminated the write-off of the energy resource (or mana) from the character in case of unsuccessful use of the following abilities:
▪ "Comet", "Hail of Blows" of the monk;
▪ "Teleport" of the sorcerer;
▪ "Furious Leap", "Berserker Leap" of the barbarian;
▪ "Step into the Shadow" of the assassin.
🔹The mechanism for writing off the energy resource (or mana) when using the following continuous abilities has been reworked: "Rain of Arrows", "Burst", "Discharge", "Fire Rain", "Power Giving".
Now the resource is spent gradually in portions, and not entirely, as it was before. However, to start using the abilities, you still need to have the amount of resource specified in them.
🔹Changes in ability costs:
▪ Pathfinder:
- Arrow Rain – cost increased from 45 to 65.
- Burst – cost increased from 60 to 65. Simplify 2 now reduces cost by 5, instead of 10.
▪ Sorcerer
- Discharge – ability cost increased from 9 to 12.
- Fire Rain – ability cost increased from 40 to 45.
▪ Priest
- Empower – ability cost increased from 15 to 17
▪ Necromancer
- Blood Stream – ability cost increased from 12 to 15.
🔹Ability upgrade points have been reset for the following classes: Necromancer, Priest, Pathfinder, Sorcerer.

Have a nice game!

notes.title: Global update is already in the game!
notes.content:
The long-awaited update of Sphere 3 is already on the servers! Here's what you need to know about it right now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/96649d4ede9193202c45a86c4075975532979156.png[/img]

🔹Alliances - a new era of politics and intrigue🔹
◽️ Create alliances from several clans, vote for important decisions, capture castles and issue decrees that will change the world!
◽️ New resource "influence" for clans.
◽️ Clan wars with the ability to fight anywhere in the Sphere.
◽️ Royal decrees that change the conditions of the game in an entire location.
◽️ Throne room with a storage for 20 million gold.
◽️ Legendary equipment for the alliance leader.

🔹Class rebalance - feel the true power of your class!🔹
◽️ Rods and daggers have become even faster.
◽️ Warriors have become stronger in battles with multiple enemies.
◽️ Necromancer monsters now pose a serious threat.
◽️ Assassins deal both magical and physical damage.
◽️ Sorcerers have received mass sleep - be careful!

🔹The new server "Theia" is waiting for you!🔹
Global update - it's time to plunge into a fresh game world and start your journey with a clean slate:
◽️ Recapture legendary castles from monsters and collect royal armor.
◽️ Claim your original nickname — without unnecessary "xxx" around the edges.
◽️ Be the first to get rare items that no one else on the server has.
◽️ Be one of the first to reach level 60 and get a special prize!

The New Year is rushing towards us, and it cannot be ignored! New Year's events have already appeared in the world of the Sphere. Long live the battles with snowballs and icicles, communication with snowmen and, of course, gifts, gifts, gifts!

🔹Event "The Feast of the Snow Whirl"🔹
◽️ Collect snowflakes, combine snowmen and get valuable rewards:
◽️ "Gift of the Whirlwind" effect — up to +40% to experience, gold, production and regeneration.
◽️ Caches with pets, powerful amulets, and even the legendary amulet of happiness!
◽️ Lots of useful prizes and guaranteed main rewards after a certain number of attempts.

🔹Snow Fairytale Season🔹
◽️ The New Year's atmosphere has engulfed the Sphere! Put on a hat, hand out gifts, and ride the legendary sleigh of Sinek Klamus.
◽️ A new pet - the magical bear Kili and a new loot collector - the snowman Lopa.
◽️ A chance to get Klamus' bag of gifts and his headdress. Ho-ho-ho!
◽️ More than a hundred different prizes for everyone!
◽️ A new season of all arenas and dungeons is a great time to write your name in history.

The update is already in the game! Come in and see for yourself. New world, new opportunities, new adventures - are you ready?

notes.title: Crystal fever
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/1019c8d71db614b616373c2c1486236dd42dc694.png[/img]

Jump into the Crystal Rush and be guaranteed to receive one of four epic bracelets with special properties:
🔹Avoidance bracelet - reduces the chance of receiving a critical hit by 6%. Only one avoidance bracelet has an effect at a time.
🔹Resistance bracelet - increases magical defense by 12%. Only one resistance bracelet has the effect at a time.
🔹Strengthening bracelet - increases physical defense by 12%. Only one strengthening bracelet has the effect at a time.
🔹Enhancement bracelet - increases the power of abilities by 4%. Only one boost bracelet can provide the effect at a time.

Crystal fever is coming to the world of the Sphere! Travelers from all over the continent repeat the same thing: the Sphere is filled with mysterious magical crystals that contain various secrets and powers. The loyal soldiers of Vagrot and King Sigurd are already preparing to get as many valuable crystals as possible, but this time not only war, but also real competition awaits everyone.
 
⚡️Awards⚡️

During Crystalmania, factions of humans and demons will begin to chase the power of the crystals. By killing monsters of your level, you have a chance to receive a Tarnished Shard, from a group of which you can create stronger crystals. Each time you combine crystals, you will receive pleasant bonuses.
 
By creating new crystals, you can get:
- items for improvement,
- teleportation stones,
- pet food,
- useful potions,
- cubes of illusions,
- resurrection scrolls.

⚡️Guaranteed prize⚡️

In addition, when you combine Unfinished Crystals, you have a small chance to receive a Crystal Stash containing one of the four Epic Bracelets, and every 25th attempt to combine Unfinished Crystals, you are guaranteed to receive a Crystal Stash!
 
⚡️Useful buffs⚡️

At the end of each day, the faction that has collected more crystals will receive a pleasant bonus to experience, gold and item drops, which will last until the next count.
 
And one more thing. For combining unfinished crystals you will receive a buff that increases the power of abilities by 0.4% and maximum health by 0.7%. The effect stacks up to 40 times, meaning you can increase the power of your abilities by 16% and your maximum health by 28%. The buff is not lost after the death of the character and will remain with you until the end of the event and 1 week after it.
 
⚡️Important details⚡️

To obtain crystals from monsters, your level should not differ from the monster’s level by more than 5 levels.
 
It must be remembered that any representative of the opposing faction can defeat you and take some of the tarnished shards before you turn them into something more useful.
 
While your premium account is active, the chance of Tarnished Shards dropping is doubled.
 
You will need cunning, attentiveness and remarkable perseverance to get as many prizes as possible and defeat your opponents. Well, enough chatter, Crystal Fever is beginning!

notes.title: Maintenance, gifts and rates
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/1195681da5b9ffb167166c712975439caa35641e.png[/img]

Urgent maintenance has been completed.

Due to a critical game error, the servers were rolled back to 11:00 UTC+3. The error has been fixed.

🎁We understand that having your progress rolled back during these hours is an unpleasant event, but, unfortunately, it could not be avoided. That's why we have prepared a set of gifts for you, including a day of premium account and a battle pass level. You can pick it up in the “Gifts” section of the game store until February 21.

💰All purchases in the game store made between 11 a.m. and 5 p.m. UTC+3 have been cancelled, and the GXP spent has been returned to customers’ accounts.

⭐Also, so that you can make up for lost time during these hours, until the end of the day on February 8, the following rates apply to you:
- x2 experience,
- x2 drop,
- x2 gold.

We sincerely apologize for this situation and hope that it did not affect your mood too much. Thank you for staying with us. Have a good game!

notes.title: The new battle season!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/4cf6dbe09eb103340eefa6d3dbbcbfe0b6a86116.png[/img]

More than a hundred gifts for every Sphere player! The bravest, wisest and noblest warriors of the Sphere are invited to participate in the new battle season!
 
[h2]What is battle season?[/h2]

Essentially, this is a set of tasks, for which participation is given progress points. As you accumulate progress points, you will receive sets of useful and sometimes even unique rewards!

[h2]Tell me more about the prizes![/h2]

✨Title "Swift" - increases movement speed by 2.5%, reduces the chance of receiving a critical hit by 1.5%.
✨Infusion of Windfury - increases attack, spell and movement speed by 5% for 24 hours
✨Loot collector "Squirrel" - moves 60% faster than usual, lasts 30 days.
✨Groom Token - used to improve the groom’s mount.
✨Pet "Nut". Its properties are below.
◾️ secretive
◾️luck
◾️level 10 - Exceptional Agility (Increases the owner's agility by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Wisdom (Increases the owner's wisdom by 1.6%)
◾️level 20 - Greater Wound Healing (During combat, restores the owner to 50% of their normal health regeneration value) OR Accelerated Recovery (Increases the owner's energy regeneration, magical or necrotic energy by 15%)
◾️level 30 - Exceptional Agility (Increases the owner's agility by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Wisdom (Increases the owner's wisdom by 1.6%)
◾️level 40 - Increasing anger (When attacked with a 6% chance, increases the speed of attack and trying on the owner’s abilities by 6% for 13s. Stacks up to 5 times.) OR Increasing strength (When receiving damage with a 6% chance, increases the owner’s defense by 6% for 14 seconds. Stacks up to 5 times.)
◾️level 50 - Exceptional Stamina (Increases the wearer's stamina by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Spirit (Increases the wearer's spirit by 1.6%)
◾️level 60 - Celerity (Increases the owner's movement speed by 22%) OR Elusiveness (Reduces the chance of receiving a critical hit by 13%.)

In addition to all this, you can get food, conservation and strengthening crystals, a refining master’s hammer, essences, ghost coins, spices and much, much more. The full set of rewards is available to those who purchase the Advanced Pass.

[h2]I'm in! How to participate?[/h2]

When you first enter the game after the start of the battle season, each of your characters will see an invitation window.
 
Click the “Start Season” button to join. After this, you can open the season window by clicking on the icon located next to the mini-map.
 
[h2]What should I do?[/h2]

Open the season window. In it you will see a list of tasks. Tasks are divided into those that you can complete once per season, and daily. One-time tasks are chained (complete the current task to start the next one). However, each group of tasks is available at the same time - as you complete simple tasks, new, more complex ones will open up.

[h2]I want more rewards and tasks![/h2]

Easily! To have access to more tasks and receive more rewards for progress points, you can purchase an extended pass. In addition to these benefits, the pass will also allow you to gain combat experience (progress points) faster. The Extended Pass is purchased once for the entire season and is valid for your entire account. You can become the owner of an extended pass and claim your rewards at any time during the season.
 
[h2]Can I get the rewards right now?[/h2]

If the romance of completing tasks every day bores you, then of course! To speed up your progress through the Battle Season and instantly gain access to rewards, you can purchase levels (a fixed number of progress points).
 
[h2]How long does the season last?[/h2]

The battle season lasts 30 days and contains 100 levels of progress!
Receive maximum gifts!
 
We wish you good luck in the new season!

notes.title: Class rebalance!
notes.content:
Friends!

As you know, we are constantly monitoring the situation in the game, paying special attention to both game statistics and your wishes. As a result, we occasionally review the abilities of certain classes to make them more relevant in today's game environment, taking into account new equipment, pets, runes, and other opportunities for strengthening.
 
Meet the seasonal game balance update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/4e6e3b1cfb083bd2e4f25d517e9f8b51dad07f7f.png[/img]

All skill buffs across all classes have been reset so you can reassign skills to reflect the new skill traits.

[h2]Barbarian[/h2]
🔹Rage🔹
◻️ Furious Strike - Cleave 2 now reduces damage dealt by 5%, up from 10%
◻️ Whirlwind - Volume 1 and 2 have been replaced with a volume that increases the radius of the ability by 2 meters. Added a Duration that increases cast time by 1.5s.
◻️ Furious Leap - The range of the ability has been increased from 18 to 20m.
◻️ Mutilate - Ability cost increased from 15 Rage to 17 Rage.
◻️ Ax Throw cooldown increased from 5s to 8s.
◻️ Skull Crusher - Buffs 1 and 2 now increase ability damage by 20%, up from 15%

🔹Combat Mastery🔹
◻️ Bull Strike - Base damage increased by 12%, weapon damage by 6%. Ability cooldown increased from 4s to 5s. Buffs 2 and 3 now increase damage by 15%, up from 10%. Simplify 1, 2 reduce the cost of the ability by 4 and 5 rage. Simplify 3 has been replaced with a duration that increases Bull Stun by 0.5s against Heroes and by 1s against Monsters.
◻️ Frightening Shout - Duration 2 has been changed to Cleave, which increases the number of targets from 5 to 8.
◻️ Berserker - cooldown increased from 35s to 40s.
◻️ Battle Fury - Enhancement 1 increases Strength bonus by 7%, up from 6%.

🔹Containment🔹
◻️ Binding - cooldown increased from 20s to 23s.
◻️ Overcome Pain - Ability cost increased from 30 Fury to 40.
◻️ Titan Walk - Base damage increased by 10%, weapon damage by 5%.
◻️ Combat Trance - Boost 1 and 2 speed cooldown by 35s instead of 30s
◻️ Steadfastness - The health threshold for triggering has been reduced from 35% to 30%.

[h2]Paladin[/h2]
🔹Retribution🔹
◻️ Righteous Strike - Base damage increased by 12%, weapon damage by 6%.
◻️ Rush - Knockback 1 increases range by 2m instead of 1m. The 2 knockback has been replaced with a cooldown that increases the amount of Zealotry generated by 5.
◻️ Judgment cost increased from 25 to 30. Volume 2 now grants 2m radius instead of 1m. Bulk 3 has been replaced with an increase that reduces the ability's cooldown by 2s.
◻️ Warrior of Light - Enhancement 3 increases stamina by 7%, up from 5%.

🔹Self-sacrifice🔹
◻️ Shield Bash - Base damage increased by 15%, weapon damage by 6%. Enhancement 1-3 now increase damage by 15% each, up from 13%
◻️ Sacrifice - Haste now increases cast speed by 0.2, up from 0.1. Haste 2 has been replaced with a cooldown that increases the amount of Zealotry generated by 5.
◻️ Conviction - Cooldown increased from 20s to 45s. Fanaticism generation increased from 20 to 40. Healing increased from 60% to 85%, damage dealt from 45% to 75%. Acceleration 1 and 2 speed up cooldown by 5s instead of 2s. Haste 3 has been replaced with a buff that increases healing and damage dealt by 5%. 2 bulge now grants 2m radius instead of 1. Replaced 3 bulge with might, which increases the cost of the ability by 3%.
◻️ Phoenix - Increase 1, 2 and 3 now have 340s cooldown reduction.

notes.title: The new battle season has started!
notes.content:
The new battle season has started!

Come one, come all! The bravest, wisest and noblest champions of the Sphere are invited to participate in a new battle season!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/756dbff7944ac91e44d47ed5c7a4cda0855d82e7.png[/img]
 
[h2]What is a battle season?[/h2]
 
The battle season is a number of challenges that can be completed to earn progress points. Accumulating progress points will give you sets of useful or even unique rewards. For example, completing the battle season will grant you a unique mount - and participating in it will earn you new magnificent titles, useful consumables, special elixirs, illusions and more.
 
[h2]I'm in! How to participate?[/h2]
 
Each of your characters will see an invitation window when you enter the game for the first time after the season starts. Click the “Begin season” button to join. Afterwards you will be able to access the season window by clicking the icon next to the mini-map.
 
[h2]What should I do?[/h2]
 
Open the season window to see the list of tasks. Some of these challenges can be completed daily and some are available only once per season. The one-time challenges are arranged as quest chains (complete the current task to unlock the next one), but all challenge groups are available to you from the very beginning.
 
[h2]I want more rewards and tasks![/h2]
 
Easily! To have access to more tasks and get more rewards for progress points, you can purchase an extended pass. In addition to these benefits, the pass will also allow you to gain combat experience (progress points) faster. An extended pass is purchased once for the entire season and is valid for your entire account. You can become the owner of an extended pass and collect your rewards at any time during the season.
 
[h2]Can I get the rewards right now?[/h2]
 
Yes! If you are bored with challenges, you can speed up your progress and immediately access rewards by purchasing levels (a set number of progress points) directly.
  
[h2]Tell me more about the prizes![/h2]

[list]
[*][b]The title "Great Alchemist" [/b]- increases the amount of gold and craft resources received by 8%.
[*][b] Flask of Windfury [/b] - increases attack, spell and movement speed by 5% for 24 hours
[*][b]Golden Armorback Mount[/b] — gives 150% speed and increases defense by 20%. 
[*][b]Loot Gatherer Mechanical Spider[/b] - moves 60% faster than usual, lasts 30 days.
[*][b]Pet "Alchemist's Relic"[/b] Its properties are below:[list]
[*] Level 10: Exceptional Strength (Increases wearer's Strength by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Intelligence (Increases wearer's Intellect by 1.6%)
[*] Level 20: Greater Fortification (Reduces physical and magical damage taken by the wearer by 3.5%.) OR Reflection (Has a 10% chance to reflect 20% of the damage taken by the wearer. Reflection chance increases by 10% every 5s, up to 100% until reflection fires.)
[*] Level 30: Exceptional Strength (Increases wearer's Strength by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Intelligence (Increases wearer's Intellect by 1.6%)
[*] Level 40: Otherworldly Power (Increases the power of physical abilities by 9%.) OR Arcane Ordinances (Increases the power of magical abilities by 9%.)
[*] Level 50: Exceptional Strength (Increases wearer's Strength by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Intelligence (Increases wearer's Intellect by 1.6%)
[*] Level 60: Veil of the Sky (Reduces damage taken by the owner and allies within 12m by 4.5%.) OR Shroud of the Deep (Increases damage dealt by the owner and allies within 12m by 4.5%. ).
[/list][/list]
In addition to all this, you can get food, preservation and strengthening crystals, a refiner's hammer, essences, ghost coins, spices and much, much more. The full set of rewards is available to those who purchase the Advanced Pass.
 
[h2]How long is the season? [/h2]
 
The combat season lasts 30 days and contains 100 levels of progress!
 
Get all the gifts!
 
Good luck!

notes.title: Full update of the castle mechanics!
notes.content:
Friends!
 
Castle sieges have existed unchanged for a long time, and the time has come for pleasant changes! There has been a real revolution in the rules you know. Read more about the new sieges and castle rewards below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/d6c2647374f86af26265b6238964d67b11acdb60.png[/img]

[h2]Changes in siege mechanics[/h2]

All castles in sieges now correspond to level 60. What does it mean? If previously the level of a player in a siege was reduced to the level of a castle, now the levels of all participants in the siege are equal to the 60th.
 
However, this does not make all castles the same - their value and power will, as before, vary from the weakest Almaerta and Bansolas to the richest and most powerful Shiai Tok. In the clans window, you can see the gradation of castles from level 60 to 100.

Let's look at some aspects of this change.

[list]
[*] The effect of the castle territory, which lowers the character's level to the level of the castle upon entering the castle territory, has been removed.
[*] Upon entering the castle territory, high-level effects and skills charging are no longer removed.
[*] At the end of the siege, PvP mode is removed from everyone and all negative buffs are removed (previously all were removed).
[*] All external merchants selling castle consumables now sell a common trade set consisting of level 60 weapons and consumables.
[*] The price of some castle goods has also been raised, for example, castle brewing elixirs.
[*] Only level 60 castle guns remained for sale.
[*] The damage of castle boilers with a burning mixture and catapults has been increased.
[*] Gates of all castles, castle monsters, castle defenders (summoned bosses for castle tokens) are now level 60.
[*] The castle carpenter remained unchanged - it restores 30% of the gate's HP at a time.
[*] Helper guards summoned with the help of a clan skill have been strengthened.
[/list]

[h2]Updated castle treasures[/h2]

The potions in the chest were replaced with potion boxes, new potions in the boxes were added (for energy, fanaticism and rage). All of them correspond to level 60, but differ depending on the level of the castle.
Previously, castle equipment had a level according to the level of the castle, but now all of it corresponds to level 60. The level of items remaining in the hands of the players will remain the same, however, when the castle is recaptured or items are recalled, their level will change to 60.
Castle buffs have been changed - they have become weaker on low-level castles and stronger on high-level ones.

We do not plan to stop at these changes - there are even more interesting updates ahead. And of course, we want to know what you think of the updated castles. We look forward to seeing your impressions and suggestions on what improvements you would like to see in the castle siege game in the comments.

Enjoy the game and exciting sieges!

notes.title: The new battle season has started!
notes.content:
The new battle season has started!

Come one, come all! The bravest, wisest and noblest champions of the Sphere are invited to participate in a new battle season!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/8efb5952d56b6a46f45cfb0c1c2d2c2c0460cb23.png[/img]
 
[h2]What is a battle season?[/h2]
 
The battle season is a number of challenges that can be completed to earn progress points. Accumulating progress points will give you sets of useful or even unique rewards. For example, completing the battle season will grant you a unique mount - and participating in it will earn you new magnificent titles, useful consumables, special elixirs, illusions and more.
 
[h2]I'm in! How to participate?[/h2]
 
Each of your characters will see an invitation window when you enter the game for the first time after the season starts. Click the “Begin season” button to join. Afterwards you will be able to access the season window by clicking the icon next to the mini-map.
 
[h2]What should I do?[/h2]
 
Open the season window to see the list of tasks. Some of these challenges can be completed daily and some are available only once per season. The one-time challenges are arranged as quest chains (complete the current task to unlock the next one), but all challenge groups are available to you from the very beginning.
 
[h2]I want more rewards and tasks![/h2]
 
Easily! To have access to more tasks and get more rewards for progress points, you can purchase an extended pass. In addition to these benefits, the pass will also allow you to gain combat experience (progress points) faster. An extended pass is purchased once for the entire season and is valid for your entire account. You can become the owner of an extended pass and collect your rewards at any time during the season.
 
[h2]Can I get the rewards right now?[/h2]
 
Yes! If you are bored with challenges, you can speed up your progress and immediately access rewards by purchasing levels (a set number of progress points) directly.
  
[h2]Tell me more about the prizes![/h2]

[list]
[*] Title "Fiery Knight" - increases health by 6%.
[*] Flask of Windfury - increases attack, spell and movement speed by 5% for 24 hours
[*] Mount "Burning Raptor" — gives 150% speed and increases health by 20%. Life time: 60d
[*] Loot Gatherer Whelp - moves 60% faster than usual, lasts 60 days.
[*] Pet "Fire Demon". Its properties are below:[list]
[*] Level 10: Exceptional Strength (Increases wearer's Strength by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Intelligence (Increases wearer's Intellect by 1.6%)
[*] Level 20: Tireless (Increases movement, attack, and casting speed by 6%.) OR Infinite Rage (Increases damage dealt by the wearer by 6%.)
[*] Level 30: Exceptional Agility (Increases wearer's Agility by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Wisdom (Increases wearer's Wisdom by 1.6%)
[*] Level 40: Secrets of Darkness (Increases Critical Strike by 3.5%) OR Scent of Blood (Increases Critical Strike by 7%)
[*] Level 50: Exceptional Agility (Increases wearer's Agility by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Wisdom (Increases wearer's Wisdom by 1.6%)
[*] Level 60: Aura of Withering (Reduces regeneration of enemies by 30%, regeneration in battle by 25% in a radius of 10 m.) OR Devouring Flame (If the owner has dealt a critical hit, his enemy is engulfed in flames, taking away 0.5% of the maximum amount of health targets once per second for 15s and reduces defense by 20%, procs no more than once every 45s Against monsters, flames reduce defense by 40%.)[/list][/list]

In addition to all this, you can get food, preservation and strengthening crystals, barony coins, a refiner's hammer, essences, gladiator's coins, spices, magic feathers and much, much more. The full set of rewards is available to those who purchase the Advanced Pass.
 
[h2]How long is the season? What if I pass it earlier?[/h2]
 
The combat season lasts two months and contains 60 levels of progress, but for the fastest shooters in the Wild West, we have 40 more levels in store! After completing the main line, you will be able to receive a supply box every 5 levels, and if you have an advanced pass, you will also receive a knight's chest every 4 levels. From them you can get various useful consumables - exaltation tokens, crystals, feathers, coins of baronies, food, a pass to the bottomless dungeon and much more.
 
Get all the gifts!
 
Good luck!

notes.title: Crystallomania
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/822861ab7cfba465583eaef72f72121922da8f3a.png[/img]

Crystallomania comes to the world of the Sphere! Travelers from all over the continent repeat the same thing: the Sphere was filled with mysterious magical crystals that hold a variety of secrets and powers. The loyal soldiers of Vagroth and King Sigurd are already preparing to get as many valuable crystals as possible, but this time not only war awaits everyone, but also a real competition.

During Crystallomania, the human and demonic factions will start chasing the power of the crystals. By killing monsters of your level, you have a chance to get a Tarnished Shard, from a group of which it will be possible to create stronger crystals. Each time you collect crystals, you will receive pleasant bonuses, and when you collect a completed crystal, you will receive not only valuable rewards, but also a long-term increase in health and damage, which will grow with each completed crystal you collect.

To receive crystals, your level must not differ from the level of the monster by 2, and to receive crystals from another player - 5 levels.

At the end of each day, the faction that has collected more crystals will receive a nice bonus that will last until the next count.

However, it must be remembered that any representative of the opposite faction can strike you and take some of the tarnished fragments before you turn them into something more useful.

Also, while the Premium account is active, the chance of Tarnished Shards dropping is increased.

By creating new crystals, you can get:
- items to improve,
- teleportation stones,
- pet food,
- useful potions,
- illusion cubes,
- scrolls of resurrection.

And the most important thing. For collecting a completed crystal, you will also receive a buff that increases the health and damage of the character by 7% for two weeks. Each successive crystal completed increases the damage and health bonus by 2.1%, but does not refresh the duration of the buff. The buff cannot be more than 17.5%. The buff is not lost after the death of the character and will remain with you until the end of the event and 1 week after it.

You will need cunning, attentiveness and remarkable perseverance to get as many prizes as possible and defeat your opponents. Well, enough talk, Crystallomania begins!

notes.title: Class rebalance!
notes.content:
Friends!

As you know, we are constantly monitoring the situation in the game, paying special attention to both game statistics and your wishes. As a result, we occasionally review the abilities of certain classes to make them more relevant in today's game environment, taking into account new equipment, pets, runes, and other opportunities for strengthening.

Today's update brought important changes to all classes, which you can read about below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/0e2863b9bdb0d4f8b735af996f85a6ceb13c9799.png[/img]

All skill buffs across all classes have been reset so you can reassign skills to reflect the new skill traits.

[h1]Barbarian[/h1]
[h3]Rage[/h3]
[list]
[*]Furious Strike - base damage increased by 5%, Cleave 3 now reduces damage dealt by 5% instead of 10%
[*]Whirlwind - base damage increased by 9%, weapon damage increased by 8.5%, reload time reduced from 25s to 20s. Buffs 1 and 2 increase damage by 20% instead of 15%.
[*]Murder - base damage reduced by 7%, weapon damage reduced by 4%.
[*]Ax Throw - Fury Level 4 increases critical strike chance by 20% instead of 15%.
[*]Skullbreaker - Enhancement 3 now increases ability damage by 20% instead of 15%
[/list]
[h3]Combat Mastery[/h3]
[list]
[*]Bull Strike - base damage increased by 8%, weapon damage by 7%. Ability cooldown increased from 0s to 4s. Buffs 2 and 3 now increase damage by 15%, up from 10%. Simplify 1, 2, and 3 reduce the cost of the ability by 3 Rage, instead of 2.
[*]Frightening Shout - 3D 2 now increases radius by 2m instead of 1m

notes.title: Antiquity history
notes.content:
While the event lasts, you can find the characters of the event in Cinderkreg if you are fighting on the side of the human kingdom, or in the Hellsong Tavern if you represent the army of demons. By completing daily tasks, you can get ancient coins and purchase special items with them.
 
Potions that temporarily enhance the character:
[list]
[*] Elixir of Dragonfire - when used, it removes 2% health from all enemies within a 8m radius per second for 12s. Only works against players
[*] Elixir of Phoenix Wing - when used, blinds everyone within a 12m radius for 8s.
[*] Elixir of Cursed Blood - when used, restores 80% of health and takes 5% of health per second for 10s
[*] Elixir of Black Anger - when used, it increases the speed of using abilities and running speed by 35% for 10s, but takes 3% of health per second.
[*] Elixir of Stone Fortress - when used, it increases physical and magical defense by 50%, but reduces movement speed by 25% for 10s.
[/list]

Unique ancient rings with unusual properties.
 
[list]
[*] The Eternal Ring has 3 different stone slots, plus three more colorless slots. The ring can have one of three effects to choose from:
[*] Taking damage has a 5% chance to increase your character's movement speed by 25% for 8 seconds.
[*] When you receive damage with a 5% chance, your character's physical and magical defense will increase by 15% for 10 seconds.
[*] Taking damage has a 5% chance to increase your character's stamina by 20% for 12 seconds.
[/list]

New titles:
[list]
[*] "Relic Connoisseur"
[*] “Master of Archeology”.
[/list]

You can buy all these outlandish gizmos from the event merchant located in the same cities, and additional coins can be obtained by killing monsters, or purchased from the GXP store.
 
Premium account doubles the chances of getting coins when killing monsters.
 
Good luck!

notes.title: Halloween in Sphere 3!
notes.content:
Trick or treat, spherians?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/0be97f2bc6c331bbe9eb8872c860d6412812eaea.png[/img]
 
Halloween is coming, which means that all kinds of evil spirits are already being selected from crypts and graves. The world of Sphere 3 has been attacked by ghosts. You have to find out who they are and where they came from! Meet the Halloween event in Sphere 3!
 
Complete tasks and fight monsters, get candy for it and exchange them for valuable prizes, including two new unique pets - Poltergeist and Jack-O-Lantern, as well as a shadow fox that not only collects loot 60% faster, but also increases health regeneration by 20% and health regeneration in combat by 10%. And of course, scary helmets!
 
In the capital, each faction already has a Strange Girl. With its help, you have to complete a very exciting chain of quests, during which you can get wonderful in-game prizes, including:
[list]
[*] unique headdress - Pumpkin,
[*] Horse of the Damned of different colors,
[*] scrolls of improvement and enchantment,
[*] inlay stones,
[*] various useful consumables.
[*] You are waiting for battles with ghosts, unraveling the mysteries of the universe, collecting various ingredients for a spell, the game "Candy or life!" and much more.
[/list]
 
Humans will be able to find the Weird Girl in the eastern part of Olannor, and demons in the west of Brionnfall. Barker can also point the way to it - he can be found in most large settlements.
 
But that's not all! During an interesting daily quest, you can also get valuable prizes, for example:
[list]
[*] candies,
[*] essences,
[*] pet food,
[*] paints,
[*] illusion cubes.
[/list]
The daily quest can be taken from Jack the Pumpkin in Olannor and Brionnfall.
 
By the way, in event pumpkins you can find another type of candy that gives a buff for the entire duration of the event and a week later and stacks up to 30 times.
 
Want more details? Then get into the game!
 
We wish you a happy Halloween!

notes.title: Birthday adventures!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10936705/fd52c09c0261abadbe9f424e27542537bdc37518.jpg[/img]

Noble warriors of Erikuria!

Sphere 3 is celebrating a birthday! In honor of this, you can receive skill reset scrolls, a new relic with 6 colorless slots and an effect that reduces the chance to get a critical hit, and much more!

In the towns, villages and camps of each race, you can find the Herald character, who will tell you about the return of the traveler and give you the first task of the chain.

For helping this wanderer, you will receive magnificent rewards, including:
[list]
[*] skill reset scroll,
[*] key boxes,
[*] items to improve
[*] mounts and loot pets,
[/list]
And that is not all!

Most importantly, while the event is running, earn Special Traveler Coins from daily quests and exchange them for purple relics with 6 colorless slots and an effect that reduces the chance to get a critical hit by 5%, wings, pets, ranks and food from special merchants!

Hurry up, very soon travelers will leave the capitals and again set off to surf the world of the Sphere!

notes.content:
While the event lasts, you can find the characters of the event in Cinderkreg if you are fighting on the side of the human kingdom, or in the Hellsong Tavern if you represent the army of demons. By completing daily tasks, you can get ancient coins and purchase special items with them.

[list]
[*] Elixir of Dragonfire - when used, it removes 2% health from all enemies within a 8m radius per second for 12s. Only works against players
[*] Elixir of Phoenix Wing - when used, blinds everyone within a 12m radius for 8s.
[*] Elixir of Cursed Blood - when used, restores 80% of health and takes 5% of health per second for 10s
[*] Elixir of Black Anger - when used, it increases the speed of using abilities and running speed by 35% for 10s, but takes 3% of health per second.
[*] Elixir of Stone Fortress - when used, it increases physical and magical defense by 50%, but reduces movement speed by 25% for 10s.
[/list]

Unique ancient rings with unusual properties.
 
[list]
[*] The Eternal Ring has 3 different stone slots, plus three more colorless slots. The ring can have one of three effects to choose from:
[*] Taking damage has a 5% chance to increase your character's movement speed by 25% for 8 seconds.
[*] When you receive damage with a 5% chance, your character's physical and magical defense will increase by 15% for 10 seconds.
[*] Taking damage has a 5% chance to increase your character's stamina by 20% for 12 seconds.
[/list]

New titles:
[list]
[*] "Relic Connoisseur"
[*] “Master of Archeology”.
[/list]

You can buy all these outlandish gizmos from the event merchant located in the same cities, and additional coins can be obtained by killing monsters, or purchased from the GXP store.
 
Premium account doubles the chances of getting coins when killing monsters.
 
Good luck!

notes.title: Pet System Update
notes.content:
Do you have a lot of pets that you don't play with? Don't do it like that, pets love attention and care! In this game update, we made it so that even those little friends whose bonuses you do not need will be useful and will be able to bring you nice and important gifts!

Introducing the Mercenary Pet System!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/fca67e1988077608bfad82f0ecf44799687f89fe.png[/img]

The essence of the system is that you can collect pumped pets in small groups and send them on special tasks. Pets go on a mission in automatic mode and after some time return with prey.

Loot is a different set of items:

pet food,
all kinds of consumables
coins of the Free Baronies,
runes,
gold,
elevation tokens,
alchemical spices
paints
and much more, depending on the level and type of task.

Let's take a closer look at the system.

Three buttons appeared at the bottom of the pets window - the actual list of pets for calling, tasks and training.

Tasks
The quest window has 6 slots, the first three are unlocked at character level 10, 30, and 50, and three more after completing 50, 100, and 250 pet quests.

When you click the "Get" button, you are prompted to select pets that will go on a mission. Depending on the selected pets, you will see the chance of successful completion of the task and the chance of receiving an additional reward. The chance to receive an additional reward appears only if you have reached 100% chance of receiving the main reward. The chance of success depends on the number of eligible pets and their desired properties.

Also, sending on a mission will require you to give a certain amount in gold. Here you can also see the time the execution will take. In the next updates, the game will introduce an accelerator - an item with which you can complete the task faster.

The tasks available to you at the moment depend on the level of your character. After completing one task, a new one immediately appears in the vacated slot. Once a day, you can reset the task in one of the task slots for free.

Pet properties
The properties of pets are exactly what is responsible for the success of their tasks. This parameter does not carry other functions yet. A pet can have one primary property and one additional property.

Basic properties:

Secretive
Fast
Magical
Beast
Strong
Crusher
Additional properties:

Speed ​​- speeds up the task by 3/6/9/12/15/18%
Luck - gives a chance for an additional reward of 1/2/3/4/5/6%
Skill - additionally increases the chance of success by 1/2/4/6/8/10%
Savings - reduces the cost of sending (if any) by 1/3/5/7/9/11%
Additional properties of pets are available for pumping in the "Training" window. Leveling them will require you to exalt tokens and gold.

Any changes to the pet's properties after they are sent to a quest will not affect the outcome of the current quest.

Now there is a job for each of your pets!

[*] Lightning Orb - Boost 3 now reduces reload time by 4s instead of 3s.

[h2]Teaching of Darkness[/h2]
[list]
[*] Torment - base damage share increased by 4%, weapon damage share increased by 4.7%

[/list]
[h2]Teaching of Light[/h2]
[list]
[*] Healing - the base share of healing increased by 1.9%, the share of healing from weapons increased by 1.8%
[*] Healing - Duration 3 increases the duration by 3s instead of 2s.
[*] Pillar of Light - base healing increased by 1.3%, weapon healing increased by 1.6%.
[*] Chain Healing - each subsequent target receives 90% healing instead of 100%
[/list]
[h2]Enlightenment[/h2]
[list]
[*] Orb of Light — base share of shield durability and share of weapon damage reduced by 14%.
[*] Innervate — buff 2 and 3 now increase stats by 2% instead of 1%.
[/list]
[h1]NECROMANCE[/h1]

[list]
[*] Marked for death - range increased from 25m to 30m
[*] Mark of the Plague — range increased from 25m to 30m
[*] Dark armor - health healing increased from 23% to 28%
[/list]
[h2]Curses[/h2]
[list]
[*] Decay - Buffs 1 and 2 now increase damage by 15% instead of 10%.
[*] Wither - the cost of the ability has been increased from 6% to 10%, the base share of damage and the weapon damage multiplier have been increased by 15%
[*] Epidemic — consumption increased from 9% to 10%, radius increased from 15m to 20m

notes.title: Might of the Forgotten
notes.content:
Traces of the might of the ancient lords of the Sphere are increasingly disturbing civilians. The immortal fairies have left their hiding place and are calling on brave heroes to stop the return of the Forgotten!

While the event is going on, you can find fairies in Cinderkrag and the Hellsong Tavern. By completing their tasks, you will receive Forgotten Coins that can be exchanged for a new rank, special potions and elixirs, as well as three eternal amulets with unique properties:
- 6 slots for stones (3 multi-colored and 3 colorless),
- ability to choose from: chance to stun the enemy, restore health, increase health

Additional coins can be obtained by killing monsters if the difference between the levels of your character and the monster does not exceed 5.

Premium account doubles the chances of a drop, and even more coins can be purchased in the store.

Good luck!

notes.title: Killer's hour
notes.content:
A black shadow appeared silently on the road leading to the city. Silently, she slipped through the ajar gates and disappeared among the houses. It is the murderer of the Legion of Death who has come to take someone's life.
For centuries, the deadly assassins of the Legion have carved out the harvest, bringing death and collecting their bloody tribute.

On 05.02, from 9 pm to 10 pm (GMT+3), the world of the Sphere will be filled with blood and the ominous laughter of Death itself, because the Hour of the Assassin will be held on the server!

Kill the most players during this time, and become an honorary member of the Legion. The updated reward will not be long in coming:
[list]
[*] 3 days of premium account
[*] 2 rare duelist potions
[*] Scroll of Great Cleansing
[*] 5 scrolls of resurrection
[*] 5 grade 2 fortification crystals
[*] Powerful magic feather
[*] Unique game title "Legionnaire of Death"
[/list]

All this will be yours!

Only unique kills of players level 15 and above will count. Murders on battlefields, sieges, arenas, etc. are also considered. Multiple kills of the same character are not counted in statistics. Results will be published within three business days after the end of the event.

Join the mysterious brotherhood of assassins, or one day they will come after your soul!

notes.title: Lost Valley
notes.content:
The world of the Sphere does not stand still - new lands are opening up, new talents and opportunities appear. We present to your attention the new global game update - Lost Valley!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/b39cdeee2eea73d54cc334256a60dc923db9de15.png[/img]

[h2]LOST VALLEY[/h2]

The Lost Valley is a massive new location for level 60 characters. Here you can test your skills, get new craft recipes, including recipes for scrolls of spells that allow you to periodically use useful skills, such as a curse, chain lightning or summon the shadow of a sorcerer.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/308c39444ec70b8be5641a9b8aafa214bea00015.jpg[/img]

In the center of the location is a dangerous ancient city, within which any character automatically switches to PvP mode. A new world boss reigns there, keeping powerful equipment and the rarest recipes. The city also contains most of the places where chests appear, which will help to quickly develop new abilities of the characters, and you can meet a unique merchant.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/27335e49c1dfebd53fa93bcc46d81228a6838849.jpg[/img]

You can get to the Lost Valley through the teleport stones in the Forgotten Lands - near the White Claw and White Blade outposts.
 
[h2]ELEVATION[/h2]

Ascension Abilities are three new skills for each class. All characters from level 40 to 60 will receive active, passive and ultimate skills.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/e23122c648ac5375297c809b9461d0d021892127.jpg[/img]

Instead of the usual scoring system, these skills can be developed using Ascension tokens, which with a small chance drop out when killing level 40-60 monsters.
 
The chance of getting tokens on the Flying Islands and in the Lost Valley has been increased, and additional tokens can be obtained by killing a new world boss and chests hidden in a new location. In the future, other ways of obtaining and spending tokens may appear.
 
And one more thing before you go to learn new skills - all affixes work on them, but only by 25% (4 times weaker than on other skills). For such powerful skills, it would be wrong for the affixes to work at full strength.
 
[h2]GLOBAL REBALANCE[/h2]

Skills of all playable classes have been revised to meet the changing conditions of the game.
 
Some skills have become more useful, some overly strong skills have become more situational. All character enhancements have been reset, allowing new combinations of enhancements to be tried out.
 
You can find out more about the changes that have been made to each class here.

Protection Limit - The maximum damage reduction granted by physical and magical protection has been increased from 75% to 85%. Together with all the other changes, increasing the limit of protection will make it possible to create much stronger and more tenacious characters.
 
* * *

The Lost Valley is a work in progress, and new enemies, crafting recipes, and quests may appear in future updates.
 
The territory of the Lost Valley will gradually fill with new events, merchants and loot.
 
We wish you a pleasant game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/dd099dd6f19f22be54ca504aec33c66ee03fad4f.jpg[/img]
 
While the event lasts, you can find a strange sorcerer who will help you stop the great dragon. The Warlock awaits you at Cinderkreg and Mist Watch if you are fighting on the side of the human kingdom, or near the Raven Legion camp and Hellsong Tavern if you are a demonic host. By completing daily tasks, you can get dragon scales and spend it on buying special elixirs or unique gloves with new unusual properties.
 
You can spend scales from a sorcerer's servant located in the same places, and additional scales can be obtained by killing monsters.
 
Here's what you can get:
[list]
[*] Hunt and fight the mighty dragon face to face!
[*] New gloves with three colored and three colorless slots, returning 15% damage to the attacker with a 5% chance (no cooldown)
[*] Title of your choice: "Dragon Slayer" (+ 2.5% PvE damage, + 0.6% crit chance), "Knight" (+ 2.5% PvP damage, + 0.6% crit chance)
[*] New booster potions and bombs
[*] Scroll to summon a golden dragon to fight
[/list]

Get your weapon ready!

notes.title: Antiquity history
notes.content:
While the event lasts, you can find the characters of the event in Cinderkreg if you are fighting on the side of the human kingdom, or in the Hellsong Tavern if you represent the army of demons. By completing daily tasks, you can get ancient coins and purchase special items with them.
 
Potions that temporarily enhance the character:
[list]
[*] Elixir of Dragonfire - when used, it removes 2% health from all enemies within a 8m radius per second for 12s. Only works against players
[*] Elixir of Phoenix Wing - when used, blinds everyone within a 12m radius for 8s.
[*] Elixir of Cursed Blood - when used, restores 80% of health and takes 5% of health per second for 10s
[*] Elixir of Black Anger - when used, it increases the speed of using abilities and running speed by 35% for 10s, but takes 3% of health per second.
[*] Elixir of Stone Fortress - when used, it increases physical and magical defense by 50%, but reduces movement speed by 25% for 10s.
[/list]

Unique ancient rings with unusual properties.
 
[list]
[*] The Eternal Ring has 3 different stone slots, plus three more colorless slots. The ring can have one of three effects to choose from:
[*] Taking damage has a 5% chance to increase your character's movement speed by 25% for 8 seconds.
[*] When you receive damage with a 5% chance, your character's physical and magical defense will increase by 15% for 10 seconds.
[*] Taking damage has a 5% chance to increase your character's stamina by 20% for 12 seconds.
[/list]

New titles:
[list]
[*] "Relic Connoisseur"
[*] “Master of Archeology”.
[/list]

You can buy all these outlandish gizmos from the event merchant located in the same cities, and additional coins can be obtained by killing monsters, or purchased from the GXP store.
 
Premium account doubles the chances of getting coins when killing monsters.
 
Good luck!

notes.title: Plague days!
notes.content:
An unknown plague has struck the world of the Sphere! During this event, you will meet with the guild of healers in the capital of your faction to help stop a new disease.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/93471f2a5d47799c4ff3fa0e82b03e76eb8ef06a.jpg[/img]

By completing the tasks of the guild representatives, you can get coins of the healers guild and exchange them for unique items of equipment, pets, masks, titles and other valuable items.
Additional coins can be found when killing monsters.

During the event, you can get the following prizes:
[list]
[*] Pet "Plague Golem" 
[*] The title “Healer” - increases the received healing and damage absorption by 2.5%
[*] The title "Plague Doctor" - increases the received healing and damage absorption by 5%
[*] Mask of the plague doctor is eternal.
[*] Healing Brew - a travel potion capable of self-healing. Heals 50% health on a 60 minute cooldown.
[*] Unique belts of rare quality with five inlay slots and an additional property to choose from:
- Belt of the plague doctor (When receiving damage with a 5% chance, it sets the enemy on fire, taking 1% of the maximum health once per second for 15s. Cooldown 120s. Affects only player characters).

Good luck!

notes.title: Alchemical cauldrons are here!
notes.content:
You may interact with cauldrons to perform special alchemical reactions by using runic and crafting resources as well as secondary reagents. The result of the reaction is completely unpredictable — you may receive a random item from the list or fail, losing the resources entirely.
 
You can see the possible outcomes in the cauldron interface window by clicking the reaction formula. Different cauldrons may give you:
[list]
[*] existing potions of all types
[*] various decoration
[*] essences of quality
[*] weapon and armor upgrade scrolls
[*] crafting recipes (including rare ones)
[*] pet food
[*] different kinds of scrolls, including banker summoning, skill reset, nickname change, etc.
[*] reinforcement and protection crystals, runic crystals, selectors
[*] new unique shoulder decorations
[/list]
To perform a reaction you are going to need the following:
[olist]
[*] 5 different components between 1 and 10 of each (depending on formula). It may be crafting resources (primary resources acquired in the open world - pants, trees, ore, minerals), runic pieces or both.
[*] Formula itself (formulas are selected from the list).
[*] “Alchemical spices" (optional) - every reaction needs some. It is a special consumable that increases the chance of creating rare and valuable items and completely prevents failure. These spices can be purchased in the store or purchased using coins of the Free Marches. Eventually there will be more ways to get some.
[*] Gold.
[/olist]
Each player has 15 alchemical attems per day (the owners of a premium account get 45). You may use an "alchemical enhancer” if you need more attempts (this item is sold in the game store or purchased using coins of the Free Marches).
 
Every cauldron comes with its own set of unique formulas. The most valuable formulas are found in castle cauldrons. The higher the castle level, the more precious the cauldron formulas are. Only the castle owners can take advantage of its cauldron. The cauldron access is also limited by the level of the location or the castle itself (for example, a level 10 character won’t be able to use a level 20 cauldron).
 
The time for alchemical research is now! Good luck!

notes.title: New PvE-PvP system and server merge!
notes.content:
What do PvP and PvE server players have in common? They both love Sphere! And what is the main difference between the two? Their willingness to participate in ruthless combat! We spent a long time looking for solutions that would please both battle enthusiasts and those who seek to gather resources in peace! The boundaries of the worlds have become blurred, and from now on both PvP and PvE players will be able to play together just the way they like it! Introducing new PvP rules! 

[h2]New rules[/h2]

We changed the rules and did our best to preserve the most interesting features available on both PvP and PvE servers. 
Peaceful zone - players cannot enable PvP mode and cannot be attacked.
Faction zone - players can enable PvP mode to attack members of their own faction who also enabled PvP mode. Members of the enemy faction in your territory are always subject to being attacked and cannot disable PvP mode, so their consent is not necessary. You will not be able to receive damage or useful buffs from players in PvP mode unless you also enable it.
Neutral zone - this is a territory where all players can toggle PvP mode as they wish. Important: you will remain vulnerable for 3 minutes after you choose to disable PvP mode. Participating in combat with other players will freeze the countdown, not allowing you to leave PvP mode.
PvP zone - this is a territory near a castle or an altar. Players can attack any other players regardless of their PvP settings.

[h2]New bonuses[/h2]

From now on staying in PvP mode will always bring 10% extra gold and experience, allow you to deal 10% extra damage and grant you 10% extra item drop chance.
Losing to other players in PvP combat no longer makes you lose accumulated experience.

[h2]Reputation[/h2]

We replaced negative karma with a system of positive and negative reputation. Your reputation can change anywhere in the world with the exception of PvP zones. Your reputation goes down each time you kill a member of your own faction and and improves every time you kill a member of the enemy faction.
You will receive a buff after reaching certain thresholds of positive and negative reputation. Your reputation decays over time, so not engaging in PvP for may days may lead to your buff diminishing or disappearing completely. 

[h2]New quests[/h2]

We introduced new PvP quests into the game. Begin by arriving to the northern entrance to Cinderkrag if you are fighting for the human kingdom or the base of the hill where Hellsong Tavern stands if you report to the commanders of Vagrot's host.
You will meet an officer who'll give you quests that can only be completed in the enemy territory and a portal stone that will take you to the required location.
According to the new rules, enemy faction territory is considered a PvP zone. PvP mode will be automatically enabled and remain active until you leave the quest zone.
Completing PvP quests will give you extra gold and experience as well honor points that can be spent on buying equipment and various consumables. You may also encounter an enemy faction world boss: defeating it grants both valuable equipment and extra honor.
We plan to increase the number of such quest locations and faction world bosses in the nearest future.

[h2]PvP-items[/h2]

In-game vendors now sell “rewards” and “treasures” - special boxes that contain random pieces of rare and epic equipment. From now on all PvP equipment can have affixes and differs in quality, and some of the epic item slots will be colorles.
We intend to add more interesting items for PvP players and will increase number of items that can be purchased with honor and dishonor points.

[h2]Server merge[/h2]

We merged our servers today. From now on your adventures will be more exciting, and sieges and battles become even more intense! The players of Anhelm and Almaert servers are now playing in the same shared world, which means everybody gets a chance to make new friends and enemies!

Let's move on to the most important question —  which PvP rules will active on the new server? They were different on Anhelm and Almaert, after all. From now on all Sphere 3 servers are subject to the new base PvP-PvE rule set. You can only be attacked if you enable PvP mode. But there's a catch: you get extra bonuses for playing in PvP mode, including a very special buff that will help you in battle. You can read more about the new rule set here. 

Here is what you need to know.
    • In case you had characters on both servers, all items in your account bank on Almaert were moved to the magic chest. If you had characters only on one server, the contents of your bank will remain unchanged on the new server. 
    • All items for sale in the auction house on the moment of the merge were returned to sellers. 
    • After the merge only the characters you had on Anhelm will be available. To bring back the characters you had on Almaert, please delete the unwanted characters from Anhelm and restore the characters from Almaert using a special tool. Character recovery will be available for one month to all players including non-members of GameXP Club.
    • In case of name conflict the original name remains with the character from Anhelm and the name of the character from Almaert gets the additional _003 suffix (if the name is shorter than 12 symbols. If the name is longer, it will be changed completely). Your character can be renamed at any time with the rename scroll we put in the magic chest.
    • In case of clan name conflict the original name remains with the clan from Anhelm and the name of the clain from Almaert gets the additional _003 suffix (if the name is shorter than 12 symbols. If the name is longer, it will be changed completely). If you are not satisfied with the name of your clan after the merge, the clan leader can contact technical support and provide 5 desirable clan name versions. Your clan will be renamed during the next server maintenance.  
    • Only Anhelm clans will retain castle ownership. All castle equipment belonging to Almaert players has been recalled. We don't want you to be upset because of this, so clan leaders who previously controlled castles on Almaert will receive gifts for their clans as compensation. 
If you find a bug or encounter a problem, please report it in the comments or contact technical support.
 
We wish you new breathtaking victories on the newly merged server!

notes.title: Recent updates and improvements
notes.content:
[h1]The following changes have been made to the game:[/h1]
[b]New gameplay mechanics:[/b]
[list]
[*] You may now obtain a title for your character. Right now it can be done by participating in the rated arena matches.
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/397040/announcements/detail/1816544902756931685]You may now upgrade the quality of your gear.[/url]
[/list]
[b]Changes to the existing mechanics:[/b]
[list]
[*] New map filters have been added to include the item recycling NPC marker. All players’ map filter preferences have been reset.
[*] Upgrade transfer has been improved: during the transfer more item levels will be shifted to the new item than before.
[*] Elite monsters may now sometimes be encountered among the common ones. They tend to be more powerful than their lesser brethren and drop better loot.
[*] The equipment effectiveness rating has been introduced to the game. It will allow you to appraise and compare the power of different items! Note that it also takes the stat bonuses from your decorative items into account. It can be seen in the item description.
[*] Character window now also displays the total effectiveness of the character’s gear (showing its actual value and the maximum value available at the current level).
[*] Equipment upgrade button has been added to the character interface.
[*] The contents of the challenge arena reward chests have been updated: increased the number of upgrade stones and upgrade scrolls.
[*] Challenge arena monster stats have been updated to increase difficulty.
[/list]
[b]Premium account benefits have been increased:[/b]
[list]
[*] Bonus experience for killing monsters has been increased from 10% to 25%;
[*] Bonus experience for crafting items has been increased from 10% to 25%;
[*] 3 additional challenge arena attempts (up from 1);
[*] Premium account owners’ equipment now degrades 10 times slower (used to degrade 3 times slower).
[/list]
[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the altar bonus remaining active in other locations.
[*] Upgrading the quality of an equipped item now correctly updates the stats of the character wearing this gear.
[*] Headgear stats are now displayed correctly.
[*] Fixed the bug which prevented monks’ fanatical rage effect from stacking.
[*] Minor interface tweaks and changes.
[/list]

notes.title: Upgrade the quality!
notes.content:
[b]Now champions of the Sphere can upgrade the quality of their gear![/b]
 
Any rare or uncommon lvl 20 or higher items can be disassembled with the help of specialists marked with the “Item disassembly” tag. These craftsmen can be found in almost any settlement.
 
Disassembling an item will destroy it and yield some essence of quality.
 
This essence can be spent at the very same specialists who also provide quality upgrade services.
 
Here’s a few tips that will help you get started:

[list]
[*] Rare items yield more essence than uncommon ones.
[*]  Items of quality yield significantly more essence when disassembled.
[*] The higher the item’s quality, the more essence you will receive by disassembling it.
[*] The higher the item’s quality, the more essence you’ll need to upgrade it to the next level.
[*] An item can be upgraded up to quality level 10, increasing its stats by up to 50%.
[*] You cannot disassemble items 5 or more levels above your character’s level.
[/list]

notes.title: Don't miss a new event in Sphere 3!
notes.content:
It’s been 26 ages since the First Builders laid the foundations of the new universe. A terrible catastrophe has befallen the young world of Sphere: strange spatial rifts are opening all over the world, from Ericuria to Tir Twayd. These rifts spawn nightmarish Devastators that seek to subjugate and enslave the living.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10936705/c15a447d9403f9f6f503d766268c3f1741a17046.jpg[/img]
 
An ancient cult of the First Builders emerged from the shadows. Guided by celestial inspiration, its mystical adepts seek to grant powerful boons and divine weapons to champions of the Sphere. These items will serve its owners only as long as the shadow looms over the world and will crumble to ash after the danger has passed.
 
The armies in both capitals are mobilizing to drive back the invaders. The brightest magicians on both sides held council and found a way to seal the rifts, but the ritual takes time and attracts additional monsters that throw themselves against the defenders.
 
You need to join these guardians and help to destroy the rifts!
 
Look for recruiters in your faction’s largest settlements to receive the first quest and start saving the world.
 
Take note: humans will find these heralds in Cinderkrag and Greenvald, while demons will find them in the camp of the Raven Legion and the Twilight Fishermen village.
 
There are three types of rifts in the world:

- the simplest rifts can be closed by fresh recruits between levels 10 and 24
- more dangerous rifts are guarded by powerful enemies and can only be closed by skilled fighters between levels 25 and 34
- most brutal and terrifying rifts can only be closed by veteran warriors and desperate daredevils between levels 35 and 45

The Ravagers and Devastators that appear from the rifts are extremely strong and treacherous. Make sure you have loyal companions before you try to defeat them!
 

Collapsing rifts leave behind plenty of useful reagents. First Builder adepts can use them to create special items that transcend time and space and will bestow these treasures upon the most worthy of heroes.
 
The event ends October, 17.

notes.title: Clan System Improvement
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10936705/12249e936234e5a13527927c5bcf8ac8699af5f7.jpg[/img]

The new clan features are finally here! Sphere 3 players may now level up their clan and enjoy special bonuses. 

[b]Clan levels[/b]
Each clan starts at level 1. There are several ways to upgrade your clan up to level 13:
 
1) [b]Experience tax[/b]. In order to level up the clan characters may contribute a share of the experience they gain by destroying monsters and completing quests. Note that the combat log shows how much experience goes to the clan and how much goes to the character.
2) [b]Book of the Forgotten[/b] may give your clan between 250 000 and 1 000 000 experience points. Such books can be obtained from level 40-50 world bosses and level 45-50 dungeon bosses. 

3) [b]Wisdom of the Forgotten[/b] can be produced by level 40 craftsmen regardless of their profession (note that every profession requires a separate formula). You may obtain formulas by killing world bosses and dungeon bosses level 40 and up. Wisdom of the Forgotten gives your clan 300 000 experience points. 

4) [b]Tablet of the Forgotten[/b] can be purchased in the game store and gives your clan 1 000 000 experience points. 

5) [b]Gold exchange[/b]. Any clan member may voluntarily contribute gold from their personal inventory to give clan experience at 1 to 1 exchange rate. A clan may receive up to 50 000 000 experience points per day in this manner.

The clan’s main page displays its current level and the amount of experience required to reach the next one. 

Clan level and total clan experience information is updated once every 30 seconds.

[b]Clan tax[/b]
Clan tax contribution can be set by the clan leader individually for each character using the special “Tax” tab in the clan window. Every player’s contribution is also displayed here. 

Clan tax can be assigned to all clan members with the exception of recruits. Clan tax cannot exceed 50%. If a character has reached maximum level, they may still contribute up to 50% of their personal experience despite not having to accumulate experience anymore. 

If a character leaves the clan or is expelled by an officer, the experience they contributed still counts towards the clan level. 

Once the clan reaches maximum level, the experience contributed by characters no longer counts towards clan progress regardless of clan tax. 


[b]Clan treasury[/b]
Clan treasury is a vault where clan members may pool their items, resources, gold, etc. In order to qualify for a clan treasury your clan needs to include no less than 10 characters of level 15 and up. 

Each tab has 60 storage slots. You may obtain up to 5 such tabs: 
[list]
[*]Tab 1 becomes available as long as the clan includes no less than 10 characters of level 15 and up. 
[*]Tab 2 becomes available at clan level 3 and costs 1 000 000 gold
[*]Tab 3 becomes available at clan level 5 and costs 2 500 000 gold
[*]Tab 4 becomes available at clan level 8 and costs 5 000 000 gold
[*]Tab 5 becomes available at clan level 11 and costs 10 000 000 gold
[/list]
The “Log” tab contains detailed information about clan treasury transactions, showing which player deposited or withdrew an item as well as displaying the exact time it happened.

The “Management” tab allows the clan leader to decide which players may deposit items and gold and which players may withdraw them. 

Permissions may only be set by the clan leader and the acting officers. The clan leader may set permissions for all players except themself. A clan officer may set permissions for recruits and privates, but not for other officers. Clan leader permissions cannot be changed.

Needless to say, clan treasury is not the only perk that becomes available as your clan advances in rank. Future updates will include plenty of other benefits that will become available to players at various clan levels.

notes.title: Enjoy the Snowy Fairytale!
notes.content:
Dear friends!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10936705/dfffefbc0f9e9a606a0c4e23cbd4090fd3b824fa.png[/img]

The most exiting winter season has come! Have you already started the celebration? We invite you to take part in the Christmas  event in [b]Sphere 3[/b].

New unique adventures and possibilities await you during this event.

Meet the [b]Frostman’s assistant[/b]! He will be your Santa during this event and will guide you through all the challenges, we prepared for you.

If you get lost, ask him, he will tell you where to find the Frostman himself.

So, what adventures are waiting for you during the event?

[list]
[*]First task offers you to save the day at once. Local monsters have stolen Christmas decorations, and the Frostman can’t finish the preparations without them. Help him to punish the monsters and return the stolen items!
[*]The Frostman lost the presents prepared for the holiday! They were seen somewhere in the area waiting for you to bring them back!
[*]Help to light the fairy lights!  To do that you will need to obtain the special Star energy from the Keepers. Find the Keeper in the location and ask for help.
[/list]
Complete all the quests to get great rewards!

After you complete all the quests for the first time, they will become dailies, so you can take them again every day while the event is running.

And of course what a Christmas without playing in the snow! Find snow banks and pieces of ice to get snow balls and icicles that you can throw to monsters of other players. They will slow the hit character down, but you have to be quick: after you get a snow ball or an icicle, you have only 5 minutes to use it till it melts and disappears from your inventory.

And now let’s start celebration of the Christmas in the Sphere 3. Winter adventures are waiting for you!

[i]We wish you a merry Christmas and a happy New Year![/i]
